subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Craigslist: The Classifieds Killer
description: Learn Craigslist: The Classifieds Killer in one minute.

hook.text: Craig Newmark started an email list about San Francisco events in 1995.

buildup.text: It grew into a website for housing, jobs, and selling anything — plain text, no frills.

discovery.text: Craigslist destroyed newspaper classified sections by offering the same service for free.

twist.text: The site's design hasn't changed in 25 years. It still looks like it was built in 1999.

climax.text: Craigslist proved that function beats aesthetics. Usefulness matters more than beauty.

punchline.text: An ugly site killed an entire newspaper industry.
